name: The Agent Economy exchanges with agent access
description: How an agent connects to each exchange in this category, how that connection runs, and whether a read only mode is documented. Rows are alphabetical by listing name.
attribution: The Agent Economy exchanges with agent access (https://theagenteconomy.si/data/exchange-agent-access.json), licensed under CC BY 4.0.

rows.name: Binance
rows.read_only: Yes: grant only the Market data and Account scopes; trades run in an Agentic sub-account

rows.name: Bitget Agent Hub
rows.connects: Remote MCP at https://agent.bitget.com/mcp (Bitget browser sign in); older local npm server @bitget-ai/bitget-agent-mcp
rows.read_only: Not documented for the hosted server as of 2026-11-12. The older local server has a read-only flag.

rows.name: Coinbase
rows.connects: Remote MCP at https://agents.coinbase.com/mcp (Coinbase OAuth); local CLI uses a CDP API key

rows.name: Kalshi
rows.connects: Remote MCP at https://api.elections.kalshi.com/mcp (Kalshi sign in for portfolio reads)
rows.read_only: Yes: the server reads data; the user places every trade

rows.name: Kraken
rows.read_only: Yes: the market, paper, and feedback set needs no credentials and cannot trade live

rows.name: OKX Agent Trade Kit
rows.runs: Local (stdio); remote MCP described as coming

rows.name: Tradier
rows.connects: Tradier hosted MCP server with a Tradier API access token
rows.read_only: Not documented as of 2026-11-11. Paper trading is a separate account selected with PAPER_TRADING.
